simple.meaning: קׇדְקֹד (qodqôd) is a Hebrew object word meaning “the crown of the head (as the part most bowed ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 49:26. The surrounding context includes family, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קׇדְקֹד (H6936) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: קׇדְקֹד (qodqôd) / H6936 is traced through Genesis 49:26, Deuteronomy 28:35, Deuteronomy 33:16, Deuteronomy 33:20 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: The blessings of your father have prevailed above the blessings of your ancestors,
Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
for the precious things of the earth and its fullness,
Now in all Israel there was no one to be so much praised as Absalom for his beauty. From the sole of his foot even to the crown of his head there was no defect in him.
So Satan went out from the presence of Yahweh, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.
I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness,
The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan,
therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion,
The children also of Memphis and Tahpanhes have broken the crown of your head.
“Those who fled stand without strength under the shadow of Heshbon;

definitions.usage: crown (of the head), pate, scalp, top of the head.
definitions.full: H6936. qodqod קָדְקֹד noun [masculine] head, crown of head ; — ׳ק absolute Deut 33:20 ; Jer 2:16 , construct Isa 3:17 +; suffix קָדְקֳדוֺ 2Sam 14:25 ; Job 2:7 ; קָדְקֳדֶ֑ךָ Deut 28:25 ; — especially poet, Gen 49:26 = Deut 33:16 ; Psa 7:17 , ׳ק שֵׂעָר 68:22 hairy crown or scalp (all || ראֹשׁ ), Isa 3:17 ; Jer 2:16 ; 48:45 (|| מֵּאָה ), so read also Num 24:17 for וְקַרְקַר (|| id. ), see Ew Di Pat and others, Deut 33:20 ; in prose only וְעַדקֿ רֶגֶל ׳מִכַּף 28:35 ; 2Sam 14:25 ; Job 2:7 . קַרְקַר Num 24:17 read קָדְקֹד q. v.
